title: Welcome tour: intro with Pelago, clicks on real screens, take it again
covers: tours/*.constants.ts, welcome.tour.ts, Take the tour entry
context: The welcome tour opens with an intro panel (the Archipelia logo, a large Pelago, Start the tour and Skip). Steps with a hint such as Click Games wait for you to click the lit part. The tour walks the menu, Home, Sessions (list, setup, saved players), History, Games, Presets, Servers, Hosting and Engine. It opens by itself on a first start and can be taken again from the menu or from Ctrl+K.
changed: tours: intro, home, sessions, library, hosting and app steps
sessions steps now cover the list and detail, Run opening a tab, saved players and History

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: state
setup.text: Any profile. The tour may open by itself on a first start. Skip it when it does; this test opens it from the menu.

setup.label: time
setup.text: About ten minutes. You do not have to read every step; the test samples them.

steps: If the tour opens by itself, press Skip. Open the menu (three lines in the title bar) and press Take the tour (under Advanced, or in the search with Ctrl+K).

The intro panel shows the Archipelia logo, a large waving Pelago, the title Welcome to Archipelia and a text that starts with Archipelia is a multiworld manager. It has Skip and Start the tour and no Back or Next. Press Start the tour.

The steps The menu, What the menu holds and Open Home wait for you: click the menu button, read the lit menu, click Home. Then Home lights the whole section and The sidebar asks you to click Sessions.

Sessions lights the page and Your sessions the list. New session waits for a click on New session. The session setup lights the top bar, Saved players the players. Back to Sessions waits for a click on Back. History lights its list.

The Library step waits for a click on Games. Games, Tabs (it names Built-in, Archipelia ready and Archipelago index) and Search and filters light their parts. Then click Presets and read the Presets step.
Hosting waits for a click on Servers. Servers and Who can reach you light their parts. Click Hosting and read it. The last stop waits for a click on Engine, and Engine lights the page.
The last step reads That is the tour and says how to take it again. Its button reads Done instead of Next. Press Done: the tour closes.
Press A result Take the tour: Welcome to Archipelia shows Enter starts Press Skip: it ends Start it again, press Start the tour and the X (Close the tour) on the second step: it closes
Close Archipelia and launch again: the tour does not open by itself.
pass: The intro shows the logo, a large Pelago, Start the tour and Skip, and Skip ends the tour at once.
Steps with a hint wait for the click on the lit part, and the page changes behind the bubble to match each step.
Each area lights the right parts, and the sessions steps describe the list, the setup and the saved players.
The tour can be taken again from the menu and from Ctrl+K, and the X closes it. After it was finished or skipped it does not open by itself at the next start.
fail: The intro has Back and Next instead of Start the tour and Skip, or the mascot is small.
A step lights the wrong part or nothing, a click step does not move on when you click, or the page behind it does not match the step.
Take the tour is missing from the menu and from Ctrl+K.
The tour opens again at every start, or cannot be closed.
notes: The code lists 27 steps in all (the lead counted 25). The number is read aloud by screen readers (Step x of N), not shown on screen, so count by area instead.
Where the bubble sits next to a highlighted part, say in your note if it hides the part it talks about.
If a Click step cannot be clicked because the bubble covers it, say which one.
